methods.notes: Do not match MousrDfu and then send ordinary commands. A renamed toy can still be found by the Nordic UART service.

identification.notes: The factory name is reported as Mousr but is user-renamable. Prefer the Nordic UART service; MousrDfu is a different bootloader identity.

device.name: Petronics Mousr
device.notes: Phone-direct robotic cat toy. Ordinary operation does not require an account or cloud service. Nordic UART is the primary command path; Laird VSP is a legacy/alternate identity. The app bundles recovery firmware, but no update was performed and no firmware is shipped in this spec. Movement and tail calibration require a clear area and supervision.

openness.notes: No public protocol implementation was found. Wire facts are derived from the recovered official app's packet builders and command metadata, not from a live capture.

pairing.notes: Static analysis found no application-layer authentication for normal commands. The guide discusses Bluetooth pairing, but whether a bond is required on every firmware/phone combination needs a live check.

safety_advisory.detail: Test STOP first and use movement only in a clear area away from pets, people, cables and edges. The app-derived drive values have no proven physical units. Do not attempt DFU until normal control and charging state are established.
safety_advisory.summary: Moving robot and tail assembly — supervise use.

credentials.notes: No account-bound credential was found for ordinary operation.

factory_reset.description: No general factory-reset procedure is established. DFU and tail calibration are not resets.
factory_reset.effect: Not established: whether autonomous-play settings, calibration or pairing state are cleared is undocumented. DFU and tail calibration are not factory resets.

methods.description: Connect over Nordic UART, enable notifications, then send documented 15-byte commands.
methods.name: Connect and subscribe

steps.action: Charge and wake the toy in a clear area.
Connect to the Nordic UART service and enable notifications on 6e400003-b5a3-f393-e0a9-e50e24dcca9e.
Send STOP before testing any other command.

setup.notes: No account or first-run cloud activation was found in the recovered app. Connect directly and subscribe before sending commands; this has not been replayed on a toy.

rejoin.notes: BLE-only; reconnect after the previous central disconnects.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The 15-byte envelope, command codes and float32 drive-vector layout come from static analysis of the recovered official 1.0.7 app. Notification payload layouts, auto-mode offsets and drive-value physical scaling remain unverified.

artifacts.artifact: Recovered official Mousr app 1.0.7, packet builders and command metadata, read 2026-11-01
artifacts.description: Establishes the 15-byte command envelope, decimal command codes, float32-LE drive vector, Nordic UART and notification vocabulary. These are reported facts from static analysis, not hardware tests.

artifacts.artifact: Mousr User Guide v1.2 recovered from that app
artifacts.description: Supports phone-direct operation and supplies movement/tail calibration precautions. No firmware compatibility claim is made.

evidence.open_questions: Drive-value ranges and physical units, notification payload layouts, auto-mode configuration offsets, bonding requirements, firmware/DFU compatibility and the exact role of the legacy Laird channel.

helpful_urls.description: Product background and the Bluetooth-direct control model.
helpful_urls.title: Mousr Kickstarter FAQ

initialization.notes: Enable the UART notification channel before control.

CommandPacket.description: The fixed 15-byte Nordic UART command envelope.

fields.description: Offsets 13-14, two characters; a one-digit code has NUL second.
fields.name: decimal_code

parse_rules: Reject packets whose total length is not exactly 15 bytes.
MOVE places three little-endian IEEE-754 binary32 values at offsets 1, 5 and 9, then code 02.
Do not label the drive values as physical speed, degrees or percent without new evidence.

NotificationVocabulary.description: Recovered notification IDs, not complete payload declarations.

protocol_details.excluded_controls: Auto-mode byte offsets, debug-log transfer, tail calibration, driver assist, tutorial control, set-time and DFU are not declared because their payload or safety sequence is not established. No reset or firmware write should be inferred from the command number alone.

remaining_unknowns: Drive values are app control values, not established m/s, degrees or percent.
Notification IDs are known but payload layouts are not; no battery or pose decoder is declared.
Auto-mode configuration has a 12-byte payload but its exact offsets are unresolved.
The app carries Nordic DFU packages, but no update sequence or version compatibility was tested.
No hardware capture confirms bonding, command acceptance or connection limits.

move.advanced_reason: Drives a moving robot. Use only small values in a clear area after testing STOP; physical scaling is not established.
move.description: Send a raw drive vector (command 2); units and valid ranges are unverified.

angle.description: Raw app control value, not proven degrees.

hold.description: Raw app control value; valid range is unestablished.

speed.description: Raw app control value, not proven m/s, percent or another physical unit.

reset_heading.advanced_reason: Changes the orientation reference used by autonomous movement.

sleep.advanced_reason: Ends the current play session until the toy is woken.

spin.advanced_reason: Starts movement; use in a clear area after testing STOP.

turn_off.advanced_reason: Powers down the toy and ends the current session.

characteristics.name: Command input
characteristics.notes: Every declared command is exactly 15 bytes: ASCII 30, a 12-byte payload (zero-filled when unused), then the two-character decimal command code. A one-digit code has NUL as its second character.

characteristics.name: UART notifications
characteristics.notes: Notification IDs are recovered, but their complete payload layouts are not. Keep the value opaque until a capture confirms the envelope rather than presenting guessed battery or pose readings.

characteristics.name: Laird VSP characteristic
characteristics.notes: Properties and live use are unconfirmed; do not write.

services.name: Legacy/alternate Laird VSP
services.notes: Identity recorded from the app. No command path is asserted for this service.
